name: portfolio_limits
label: owner settings, starting values
note: Concentration limits for the position size analyst. They describe how concentrated the owner is willing to be; they are not measured from data, so the owner sets and changes them. A new version keeps the old file in history/. diversified_funds: owner list of symbols (such as index ETFs) that are funds; sector 'diversified fund', no single-stock limit, still counted in weights, risk share and the top five. NIFTYBEES confirmed by the owner as an index fund (26 Nov 2026).
